{"settings":"{
  // Frontend profile
  "window.title": "${activeRepositoryName} - ${profileName} profile",
  "workbench.colorCustomizations": {
    // Background colors
    "titleBar.activeBackground": "#64202f",
    "titleBar.inactiveBackground": "#64202f",
    "activityBar.background": "#64202f",
    "statusBar.background": "#64202f",
    // Borders
    "titleBar.border": "#64202f",
    "statusBar.border": "#64202f",
    // Foreground colors
    "statusBar.foreground": "#ffffff",
    "titleBar.activeForeground": "#ffffff",
    "titleBar.inactiveForeground": "#ffffff",
    "activityBar.foreground": "#ffffff",
    "activityBar.inactiveForeground": "#ffffff"
  },
  "workbench.editor.showTabs": "single",
  "workbench.statusBar.visible": false,
  "files.autoSave": "afterDelay",
  "javascript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "prompt",
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "playwright.reuseBrowser": true,
  "playwright.showTrace": false,
  "typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "prompt",
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "editor.formatOnPaste": true,
  "files.autoSaveDelay": 10000,
  "typescript.referencesCodeLens.enabled": true,
  "typescript.referencesCodeLens.showOnAllFunctions": true,
  "javascript.referencesCodeLens.showOnAllFunctions": true,
  "javascript.referencesCodeLens.enabled": true,
  "workbench.activityBar.location": "top",
  "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows": "PowerShell",
  "workbench.layoutControl.enabled": false,
  "workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMinWidth": 100,
  "editor.smoothScrolling": true,
  "editor.minimap.enabled": false,
  "window.commandCenter": false,
  "workbench.iconTheme": "material-icon-theme",
  "material-icon-theme.folders.color": "#c7b179",
  "[json]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
  },
  "editor.mouseWheelZoom": true,
  "workbench.sideBar.location": "right",
  "editor.pasteAs.preferences": [
    "text.updateImports.jsts"
  ],
  "[typescript]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
  },
  "explorer.openEditors.sortOrder": "alphabetical",
  "explorer.openEditors.visible": 10,
  "vsicons.dontShowNewVersionMessage": true,
  "cSpell.userWords": [
    "uuidv"
  ],
  "github.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.enabled": true
}"}
